summary: SandRidge Energy filed an 8-K reporting three items: (1) approval of Amendment No. 3 to the Tax Benefits Preservation Plan extending its expiration from July 1, 2026 to July 1, 2029, subject to stockholder approval at the 2027 Annual Meeting; (2) stockholder approval at the June 2026 Annual Meeting of an amendment to the 2016 Omnibus Incentive Plan extending its term to June 10, 2036; and (3) the appointment of one director and the election of four directors as disclosed in the 2026 Proxy Statement. These are routine governance and equity plan extensions, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or activist event occurred.
